business_summary: Phibro Animal Health Corporation (Nasdaq: PAHC) makes animal-health products, medicated feed additives and nutritional specialty ingredients, including a poultry franchise, and discloses avian influenza in its own 10-K. It is the smallest and, by revenue concentration, most animal-health-pure name of the four issuers on the animal-health-vaccines link: FY2026 (ended 2026-06-30) revenue of 1,518,093,000 against Zoetis' 9,467,000,000, Elanco's 4,715,000,000 and Merck's 65,011,000,000. The link is scored UNDISCOVERED (impact 70, crowdedness 34, capture 40, as of 2026-09-10), the same 'option with a large payoff and an unlit fuse' contingent on a USDA poultry-vaccination authorization that has not been made.
